department: Department of Civil, Environmental & Architectural Engineering

deadline.value: International PhD applications are due December 1 (domestic December 15); year inferred for the 2026-27 cycle.
deadline.quote: Fall Admission Deadlines | Dec. 1: International PhD

gre_general.quote: No, the GRE is not required.

supervisor.value: An initial faculty advisor is named in the acceptance letter, so advisor matching is part of admission.
supervisor.quote: Your initial faculty advisor will be listed in your acceptance letter attached to the e-mail with your admission decision.

funding.value: The admissions committee considers admitted students for assistantships and fellowships; recipients are selected during admissions.
funding.quote: The admissions committee automatically considers admitted students for graduate assistantships/fellowships; there is no separate fellowship application. Recipients are selected during the admissions process

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed; many students enroll directly with a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: No. Many of our students enroll directly from their undergraduate institution with only a Bachelor’s degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Environmental Engineering is a separate PhD program with its own row (TOEFL 91, IELTS 7.0; deadline December 1 international) and is not covered.
